description: This file contains a decorator class for caching catalog item data in local storage, implementing the ICatalogItemService interface to add caching behavior to the catalog item data retrieval and modification methods.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService that adds caching via local storage to reduce redundant data fetches.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, checking cache first.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items, utilizing cache if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a catalog item by its ID, using the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and updates the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Helper method to refresh the local storage cache of catalog items.
